title: CheckpointEvidence
description: Signed checkpoint/fork evidence envelope. Its checkpoint fields correspond to checkpoint.schema.json; created_at_ms is the AEP envelope timestamp equivalent of the core checkpoint timestamp. When present, fork_of identifies the parent run and new_run_id identifies the branch, as defined by fork.schema.json.

trace_id.description: Optional correlation ID linking related evidence records

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the record was created (checkpoint creation time)

parent_run_id.description: Identifier of the run this checkpoint was taken from

fork_of.description: Identifier of the parent run from which a new run was forked, or null if this is not a fork

new_run_id.description: Identifier of the newly created run when this evidence records a fork

state_digest.description: Content digest of the checkpointed run state, for tamper-evident resume

metadata.description: Optional non-authoritative producer context for the checkpoint

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the record content
